description: Delete a suite. Its tests stay in the library and in their other suites unless delete_tests is true; past runs always stay. The Core suite cannot be deleted. Name the suite and, with delete_tests, its tests when you ask the user. Deleting cannot be undone. Before you call this, look the item up so you know it exists; if it does not, say so and ask nothing. Then tell the user plainly what will be deleted, naming it as the lookup shows it, and ask whether they are sure, in words like: "You asked me to delete <what>. Are you sure you want to proceed?" Then stop and wait. Call it only when the user's next message confirms that exact item. If several items could be meant, list them with their ids and ask which; the user's choice is not a confirmation, so name the chosen item with its id and ask again. If they decline, hesitate, ask something else or change the request, do not delete; ask again before deleting later.

delete_tests.description: Also delete the suite's tests, from the library and every other suite. Only when the user asked for that.
delete_tests.title: Delete Tests

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
